title: Radiators and Interior
author: Coral Eastwick
blurb: Beatrix Quintana, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
